title: Started working on boss mechanics
author: Old_man_junky
selftext:
Wanted some variation between standard fights and bosses so added a sort of interactive cut scene. 

Needs polish but overall happy with first attempts 

*The cut aways are no longer so blunt and instant*

For context one boss is a mercenary captain and one of his abilities is to bribe a unit to change sides mid match, or you can outbid him with your own in game currency. 

The other is a mad king boss, his wheel of misfortune ability has the chance to kill any non king unit on the field, your side and his own, spin again, burn everyone for 1hp, spin again, extra xp, gold or Uno reverse (two random units trade current hp) the faces one the wheel change based on who is on the board and if units get killed they double up on what's left. 

Still recording vocal lines, about 365/926 done

comments.author: joeban1
comments.body:
Sort out that token AI look deep-fried roulette wheel scene as top priority, looks horrible.

Blows my mind people can create things like that and be OK with it

replies.author: Old_man_junky
replies.body: Cheers for the feedback, not sure where I said I'm ok with it 🤣.  First attempt is usually proof of concept

comments.author: Old_man_junky
comments.body: Re-working this today, "second attempt" gone for a stand up wheel and building the scene around the wheel and not directly from the generated art, this feels like a better approach more circle hole and peg than square.
